expected.text: incr_counter removes the lock directory even when it did not acquire the lock, so it can delete a live holder's lock and let two writers in.
Deny messages tell the user to run `playbook mode ask`, but that cannot lift the guard when auto mode comes from the PLAYBOOK_MODE environment variable.
acquire_dir_lock never clears a lock directory left by a killed holder, so every later caller waits out its whole retry budget.
